**A is correct: the bank cannot execute against the property after his death.** In a lien-theory state, a mortgage is only a lien on the borrower's interest and does not sever the joint tenancy, so the property passes to the woman by survivorship free of the lien. The shared note is wrong on this point because its "title transfer" rule describes title-theory states, not the lien-theory state this question specifies.

CONFIDENCE: 85
